summary.prose: Building this Story adds a fully in-plugin scratchpads feature to the VS Code chat, in seven small units: a vscode-free filesystem store over ~/.insrc/scratches (the trickiest part — atomic link-only publication, no-follow reads, idempotent delete), additive direction-isolated protocol messages, a shared CSP shell extraction, the chat status-bar button + popup menu + input insertion, a scratch-panels controller with the tabular browse-all view, its singleton document view with the floating Send-to-chat button and generation/epoch guards, and finally the extension-host wiring that ties store + panels + handlers together. No daemon IPC is introduced anywhere; every unit is proven by unit/integration fake-dom+fs tests, with an optional manual smoke as the only non-automated level.

acceptanceChecks: vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-store.ts + __tests__/fake-scratch-fs.ts are new files only (no edits to existing modules)
createScratchStore({root}) with fs omitted defaults to the node adapter; production wiring passes only { root, logger }

listScratches() returns ScratchEntry[] {id,name,mtime,size} sorted mtime desc (ties id asc), ENOENT readdir -> [], skips non-files/failed stats/non-.md, optional limit cap (menu uses 5; browse-all omits)
createScratch(title, body?) writes <yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<slug>.md (slug: lowercase, spaces->dashes, non [a-z0-9-] dropped, all-symbol -> 'scratch'), collision ladder -2,-3 via lstat probes

publication is link(temp,new)+unlink(temp) ONLY (never rename): temp name has pid+random suffix and does not match *.md; EEXIST -> next suffix; post-link unlink failure is non-fatal and never returned as failure

readScratch validates id (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.md$, not '.'/'..', resolve strictly inside root) then open(O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW)+fstat regular file -> else ScratchRefused; ENOENT at open or fd-read -> ScratchNotFound; single fd is source of truth
deleteScratch validates via lstat regular file (symlinks refused -> ScratchRefused), unlink only (never recursive), ENOENT at lstat or unlink treated as success (idempotent)
error mapping: EACCES/ENOSPC/EROFS/not-a-dir -> ScratchStoreError; unit tests with fake fs prove refusal paths make ZERO fs mutation calls
unit suite scratch-store.test.ts passes incl. two-instance concurrent-create race over a real tmp dir proving exclusive publication

No daemon IPC.

citations.quotedText: The attach flow is untouched: #insrc-attach button, .attachbar, and the 'pick-attachments' host case at chat-panel.ts:3566 keep their exact behavior; the scratchpad button is a sibling, not a modification. Webview CSP invariant: scratch content is rendered via textContent/escapeHtml only — never innerHTML with user content; new panels reuse the CSP+nonce shell from createWebviewPanelHost (panels/webview-host.ts:162). Send-to-chat never auto-sends a turn: insert-into-input only inserts text into #insrc-input (:2784) and focuses it; the user presses send.
